text:
incident-bot: SEV2 alert — sustained 429s seen for tenant=quantum-sys-prod (VPC, enterprise). 90th pct errors across requests in the last 3m. Paging oncall.

samir (oncall): paging — I’m on it. tagging @laura_csm for customer contact.

laura_csm: I’m awake, incoming message to Quantum Systems. They say web app is failing payments page, multiple customers. Asking for ETA and mitigation.

junior-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-691. Severity: Elevated.

samir (oncall): quick checks — is this isolated to their dedicated pool or shared hosted? marco_ops?

marco_ops: digging — looks like increased 429 rate between pool-qs-eu-01 nodes. Metrics show per-tenant token rate exceeding contract by ~3x over last 5m. No node OOMs.

eve-engr: logs attached (snip):
```
[2026-03-15T02:18:02Z] tenant=quantum-sys-prod 429 reason=quota_exceeded route=/v1/generate tokens=432 per_min_limit=120
[2026-03-15T02:18:05Z] tenant=quantum-sys-prod 429 reason=burst_limit route=/v1/chat tokens=512
```

samir (oncall): thanks. So it's quota hit. Two possible mitigations: 1) temporary emergency override for tenant in pool, 2) route specific endpoints to fallback model (lower cost) to reduce token usage, 3) ask customer to throttle. Which can we do fast?

marco_ops: We can stage a temporary quota override via the admin API. It’s an authenticated operation (requires CSM signoff for enterprise). Command ready:
```
POST /admin/v1/tenants/quantum-sys-prod/quota/override
Body: {"tokens_per_min": 2000, "expires_in": 3600}
# admin-audit required
```

laura_csm: I have verbal from customer rep — they approve a short emergency lift for 1 hour. I’ll record the approval in the ticket.

samir (oncall): OK laura authorized. marco, can you apply the override and confirm? tag me when done.

marco_ops: running now.
```
> curl -X POST "https://admin.redwood.internal/admin/v1/tenants/quantum-sys-prod/quota/override" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -d '{"tokens_per_min":2000,"expires_in":3600}'
```

marco_ops: response: 200 OK, override_id=ovr-1861-qs-prod-1, audit_id=audit-65432. Applying to pool-qs-eu-01.

deploy-bot: quota-override applied by marco_ops (override_id=ovr-1861-qs-prod-1) — propagation to all routing nodes started.

samir (oncall): monitoring...

marco_ops: post-override metrics: 429 rate dropped from 38% -> 2% over 90s, p95 latency stable. Throughput increased to expected.

laura_csm: customer reports payments page recovered. They saw transient errors for ~4 minutes after lift then steady. Thanks for fast action.

samir (oncall): good. Two follow-ups: 1) schedule a follow-up with Customer Success to discuss long-term quota adjustment and traffic pattern; 2) file a retro with RM for why this exceeded contracted limits (sudden rollouts?)

eve-engr: note — we observed a sudden client-side surge: multiple parallel requests from token refresh loop in their JS SDK. I'm attaching traces. Recommend we coordinate with QS to patch SDK to exponential backoff.

laura_csm: I’ll loop in their engineering lead. They asked if we can extend the override for another hour while they rollback the offending deploy. Can we do a 1h extension?

samir (oncall): per policy, extensions require documented approval. laura, can you confirm approval in thread or ticket?

laura_csm: confirmed in ticket INC-2026-691 — customer approved another 60m.

marco_ops: applying extension:
```
PATCH /admin/v1/overrides/ovr-1861-qs-prod-1
Body: {"expires_in":7200}
```

marco_ops: extension applied, override now expires at 2026-03-15T05:10:00Z. audit_id=audit-65433.

samir (oncall): logs look clean. Scheduling follow-up: Assigning to eve-engr for SDK trace analysis, marco_ops to propose safe long-term quota increase or burst policy, laura_csm to run customer coordination.

eve-engr: starting trace analysis. Early finding: non-idempotent retries from their background worker caused fan-out. Will produce a short tech note.

marco_ops: posting suggested long-term mitigations: 1) define tenant burst window (short high-rate allowed with token-bucket), 2) allow per-route throttling to protect critical endpoints (payments), 3) offer burst credits add-on. Will draft and share.

samir (oncall): closing note — incident stabilized, emergency lift in place until override expiry. Will remain open until postmortem created and customer queue mitigations complete. If override needs earlier revoke, ping this thread.

laura_csm: thanks everyone. I’ll update customer and confirm once they complete rollback. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-691 status: mitigated -> monitoring.

samir (oncall): marking handoff to next oncall at 03:30 UTC — @eve-engr you have the follow-ups.

eve-engr: got it, taking over.

samir (oncall): thanks team. Closing thread for now.
